column1: # Stage S13 W1, second of four: the single-page app and its offline service worker leave `apps/`
# for the new frontend layer folder `crates/frontend/shell/`, beside each other as the two peers
# of the shell layer: the app becomes the crate frontend_application, the worker keeps its name.
# The app's documentation hub and its frame's feature docs become the app crate's documentation
# workspaces' docs join the workspace crate documentation under
# `documentation/crates/frontend/workspaces/`, whose README takes over their index.
# The package rename (`frontend` -> `frontend_application`) is in the crate's manifest; `frontend`
# is a common word, so package and binary names in commands (`-p frontend`) have no `text` row
# and are edited by hand. Neither crate has a library, so no Rust path changes.
# The two crates of the shell layer
# The app's documentation mirror, and the planned workspaces beside the built ones
